lens: Second-round selection-science re-review of evaluation validity, partition independence, criterion-level authority, profile compatibility, and model-calibration guardrails for the 2026-09-01 evaluation platform proof.

findings.criterion: Release-readiness validity requires named human-gold authority and completed calibration evidence, not only deterministic or informational checks.
findings.observation: The platform now encodes criterion-level adjudication, partition separation, runtime profile compatibility, and informational-only model semantics, but the reviewed release bundle still provides no named human-gold criterion records and no delivered 60-case calibration artifact. The proof correctly keeps release-readiness at needs_review, so the boundary is safer than round 1, but human-workflow and non-informational model-validity claims remain unproven.
findings.evidence: packages/evaluation/src/contracts.ts:94-105 and 199-215 define criterion-level adjudication and make scenario adjudication a derived summary only. apps/eval-runner/src/opik/importAnnotations.ts:287-319 requires atomic criterionId, adjudicationDecisionId, adjudicatorRef, createdAt, and evidenceLocators before a human-gold record can become authority. evals/v2/suites/p0-release.v1.json:7-128 registers all 12 P0 cases as adjudication 'unreviewed' with the empty criterionAdjudicationDigest. docs/evaluations/2026-09-01-evaluation-platform/opik-integration-proof.json:10-15 excludes release-approval claims, and 134-140 reports releaseReadinessPassCount 0, releaseReadinessNeedsReviewCount 12, reasonCode HUMAN_WORKFLOW_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED. The reviewed proof directory contains no separate human-gold bundle or calibration artifact.
findings.user_impact: A stakeholder could misread the 12 deterministic P0 passes as broader release validation, even though the evidence required for recruiter-workflow authority and any calibrated model-use claim has not yet been produced.
findings.recommendation: Keep release authority blocked until the proof package includes a content-addressed human-gold or adjudication bundle for the relevant human-workflow criteria, plus a versioned calibration artifact showing at least 60 unique case-criterion decisions with confusion, false-pass, false-fail, abstention, adjudication-rate, order-stability, and repeat-stability outputs.
findings.verification: Verification passes when reviewers can inspect the named human-gold authority records and calibration artifact directly from the proof package, and release-readiness moves beyond needs_review only after those artifacts satisfy the stated thresholds. If those artifacts are absent, the correct falsifiable outcome remains needs_review.

strengths: Partition independence is materially stronger: packages/evaluation/src/contracts.ts:25-31 makes p0 a real mutually exclusive partition, and node apps/eval-runner/dist/cli.js validate reported p0/dev/held_out/red_team = 12/6/8/10 with contaminationFindingCount 0 on 2026-09-01.

Scenario, profile, and attempt boundaries are enforced in the runtime path: apps/eval-runner/src/modeDispatch.ts:55-64 rejects incompatible profiles, 67-109 builds model-visible inputs without oracle fields, and apps/eval-runner/src/runSuite.test.ts:202-217 covers the incompatible-profile failure before persistence.

Model judge guardrails now match the intended non-authoritative role: apps/eval-runner/src/calibration.ts:155-216 requires 60 unique case-criterion decisions plus order, repeat, and adjudication thresholds; 271-299 enforces pair identity; and apps/eval-runner/src/modelReviewer.ts plus packages/evaluation/src/gates.ts keep gateAuthority false and P0 results informational only.
missing_evidence: No versioned human-gold or adjudication artifact for the P0 human-workflow criteria was provided in the reviewed proof package.

No delivered calibration summary or raw decision set demonstrating 60 unique case-criterion decisions, order pairs, repeat pairs, false-pass, false-fail, abstention, and adjudication-rate outcomes was provided in the reviewed proof package.
open_questions: Where will future proof packages publish the authoritative human-gold and adjudication records so reviewers can verify them directly instead of inferring only from suite metadata?
Which exact non-P0 surface, if any, is intended to consume the calibration summary once a 60-case artifact exists, given that model gateAuthority remains correctly false?
